pattern: each other {g:Filter} becomes a copy of {p:Obj} {d:Dur} , except {x:CopyExceptEach}
subject: none

examples.text: Choose target nonlegendary creature you control. Each other creature you control becomes a copy of it until end of turn, except those creatures aren't legendary.
Choose target Elf you control. Each other Elf you control becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except those creatures aren't legendary.

counterExamples: Choose target creature you control. Each other creature you control becomes a copy of it until end of turn, except those creatures are legendary.
Choose target creature you control. Each other creature you control becomes a copy of it until end of turn, except those creatures aren't legendary and have haste.

pattern: each {g:Filter} other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of {p:Obj} {d:Dur} , except {x:CopyExcept}
subject: none

examples.text: Choose target Elf you control. Each Elf you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary.
Choose target nonlegendary creature you control. Each creature you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it's 1/1.

counterExamples: Choose target creature you control. Each creature you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it is legendary.
Choose target creature you control. Each creature you control other than the chosen creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it has haste if it's a Wall.

examples.text: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 2/2 green Bear creature token, then copy that spell. The copy targets that token.
Whenever you cast an instant spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying, then copy that spell. The copy targets that token.

counterExamples: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, create a 1/1 red Soldier creature token with haste, then draw a card. The copy targets that token.
Whenever you cast a spell that targets only a single creature you control, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy. The copy targets that creature.
